row.name: Manhattan Associates Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=28 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=1 giveback=0.3 tightness=0.65 base_volume_vs_leg=0.67 base_volume_vs_avg=0.76
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 28 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 0.2% vs its 20-SMA, 0.9% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: Both RE and VOL are hard FAILs: the burst bar is only 85% of the prior 5-bar range and volume came in at 48% of the 50-session average on a base that explicitly requires 1.5x average volume — two independent measured defects that together undermine the core burst premise. The base is also 28 sessions, well outside the 3–20 window, earning only a PARTIAL on C. The chart confirms a long, drifting consolidation from early August through early October with multiple wide overlapping bars inside the shaded box and visible prior trading clustered around the 210–220 zone that now sits as overhead supply above the signal close.
claude.key_risk: Prior breakouts worked only 1 of 4 times in the last 60 sessions, and the stock is pressing into a dense overhead supply zone between ~210 and ~227 with no volume conviction on the burst day.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the prior consolidation highs near 210–212 without a clean continuation, or if the first 30 minutes show a fade back below the signal day's close of 206.78.
